chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Rafa'ah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him, 'Do the people go out to Mina in the morning?' He said, 'Yes, until the setting of the sun.'

key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a valley and campsite near Mecca used during Hajj

ai.seo_question: When should pilgrims depart for Mina during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the temporal flexibility of the Mina stay, confirming that pilgrims may depart for Mina at dawn and remain until sunset, which aligns with the broader legal principle of the 'days of Tashriq'. It underscores the practical ease granted to pilgrims in fulfilling the ritual of staying in Mina, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Sunnah of the Ahl al-Bayt in interpreting Hajj logistics. This ruling is often cited in fiqh discussions regarding the distinction between the obligatory stay and the permissible duration of presence in the tent city.
